items.title: How many company-wide bets can a finite influence budget actually carry?
items.description: Yuki has about 120 spendable hours a year outside her actual job, and a bet needs roughly 30 sustained hours of writing, revising, and seeding to reach real, durable adoption. Drag the slider to see how spreading that same 120 hours across more simultaneous bets changes the number that actually land — notice the number of bets landed rises, then falls, as attempted bets increase.
items.compute: let totalBudget = 120; let hoursPerBet = totalBudget / params.concurrentBets; let ratio = Math.min(hoursPerBet / 30, 1); let successRate = 0.85 * ratio * ratio; let landed = params.concurrentBets * successRate; return { landed: Math.round(landed * 100) / 100 };

outputs.label: Bets likely to reach real, durable adoption
